create_UEDMaze_env: create a UEDMaze environment instance with configurable height, width, and number of walls for maze design
reset_UEDMaze_env: reset the UEDMaze environment to prepare a new maze design from a blank slate with random agent direction
step_UEDMaze_env: step the UEDMaze environment by placing a wall, goal, or agent at a specified tile position
get_env_instance_UEDMaze: get the maze environment instance encoding with agent position, goal position, and wall map from internal state
register_UEDMaze_ued: register the UEDMaze environment as a UED environment with the Maze ID for environment lookup
